description:
## [1.18.1](https://github.com/ahmedyarub/morphe-patches/compare/v1.18.0...v1.18.1) (2026-10-21)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Instagram:** Port four piko fixes to 452 ([6a4dbf0](https://github.com/ahmedyarub/morphe-patches/commit/6a4dbf0bb79d436102381df7f47e68c4b9963acc))

patches.name: Auto not interested
patches.description: Skips the reason popup and auto-submits when tapping Not Interested.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Blocks analytics requests sent to Instagram and Facebook servers.

patches.name: Disable screenshot detection
patches.description: Disables screenshot detection in direct messages and stories.

patches.name: Download media
patches.description: Adds ability to download posts, reels, stories and highlights

patches.name: Download voice message
patches.description: Enables ability to download voice messages

patches.name: Filter stories
patches.description: Hides categories of stories from the story tray.

options.description: Shows only stories people posted: their own stories, close friends, shared and collab stories, lives and subscriber stories. Hides every suggestion, prompt, music and ad card Instagram adds to the tray or injects while watching, whatever the options below say.
Hides advertisements from the story tray.
Hides suggested users and creators from the story tray.
Hides resurfaced highlights, which carry no expiry, from the story tray.
Hides "Add Yours" / "Your Turn" stories from the story tray.

patches.name: Hide Instants
patches.description: Hides Instants from DMs page.

patches.name: Hide Threads profile button
patches.description: Hides the Threads button from the profile page action bar (top right of the profile page).

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Hides ads in the feed and in the Following feed.

patches.name: Hide suggested content
patches.description: Hides suggested reels and suggested accounts. Suggested stories are hidden by Filter stories.

options.description: Hides suggested reels from feed and reels tab.
Hides suggested accounts from the list of followers and from other profiles.

patches.name: Improve image viewing
patches.description: Requests the maximum resolution images from the server.

patches.name: Make ephemeral media permanent
patches.description: Changes unexpired view once, view twice media to permanent view. Opening such media no longer sends Instagram a seen receipt, so it is still there after the chat refreshes.

patches.name: Open links externally
patches.description: Opens links in the system browser instead of the in-app browser.

patches.name: Reorder menu options
patches.description: Moves Interested and Not Interested to the top of the post menu.

patches.name: Sanitize share links
patches.description: Removes tracking parameters from links shared out of the app.

patches.name: Save deleted messages
patches.description: Keeps a local copy of incoming DMs so ones the sender deletes stay readable. Messages are stored unencrypted in the app's private storage.

options.description: How long a copy of a message that was not deleted is kept. A message deleted after this is not recoverable. Deleted messages are kept until cleared.

patches.name: Remove Reddit Pro section
patches.description: Removes the Reddit Pro section from the community drawer, and the Reddit Pro promos: the post creation and subreddit join upsell sheets, and the Reddit Pro banner on the profile feed.

patches.name: Remove Resources and Games on Reddit sections
patches.description: Removes the Resources and Games on Reddit sections from the community drawer.

patches.name: Add ability to copy media link
patches.description: Adds "Copy media link" to the post menu: the direct links of the post's photos, videos and GIFs.

patches.name: Custom download folder
patches.description: Saves downloaded photos and videos to a folder of your choice instead of Download/X.

options.description: Relative to shared storage, starting with Download, Pictures, Movies, DCIM or Documents, e.g. Pictures/X or Download/Twitter.

patches.name: Custom share menu
patches.description: Hides options from the post menu.

options.description: The post action types to hide, e.g. Follow, AddToList, Mute, Block, Report, Embed, NotInterested.

patches.name: Custom sharing domain
patches.description: Shares and copies links with another domain, such as fxtwitter.com, in place of x.com.

options.description: The domain shared links point at, without https://.

patches.name: Customize Inline action Bar items
patches.description: Hides actions from the bar under each post.

patches.name: Customize Navigation Bar items
patches.description: Hides tabs from the bottom navigation bar. Home always stays.

patches.name: Customize default reply sorting
patches.description: Sets the sort replies open with.

patches.name: Customize explore tabs
patches.description: Hides tabs from the Explore page.

options.description: The ids of the tabs to hide, e.g. trending, news, sports, entertainment. The server names them, so they are matched without regard to case, hyphens or underscores.

patches.name: Customize notification tabs
patches.description: Hides tabs from Notifications. At least one tab always stays.

patches.name: Customize search suggestions
patches.description: Hides kinds of suggestion from the search box.

patches.name: Customize search tab items
patches.description: Hides tabs from search results. At least one tab always stays.

patches.name: Customize side bar items
patches.description: Hides rows from the side bar.

patches.name: Customize timeline top bar
patches.description: Hides tabs from the top of the home timeline. At least one tab always stays.

options.description: Hides the + tab that pins a new timeline to the top bar.

patches.name: Delete from database
patches.description: Adds options to the Morphe settings to delete cached promoted entries or clear cached timelines.

patches.name: Disable auto timeline scroll on launch
patches.description: Opens the home timelines where you left them, instead of at the newest posts.

patches.name: Enable Undo Posts
patches.description: Holds each post for a few seconds before sending it, so it can be undone.

options.description: Seconds a post waits before it is sent.

patches.name: Enable debug menu for posts
patches.description: Adds "Post data" to the post menu: everything the app knows about the post, as text.

patches.name: Enable force HD videos
patches.description: Always plays videos at the highest quality the device supports, whatever the connection.

patches.name: Feed filters
patches.description: Adds feed filters to timelines: media only (images, videos, GIFs), hide followed profiles, and include/exclude keyword filtering. Toggle each filter from the Morphe settings.

options.description: When set, only posts containing at least one of these are shown. Edit in the app.

patches.name: Filter posts by keyword
patches.description: Hides posts whose text contains any of your keywords, ignoring case. Edit the keywords from "Filtered keywords" in any post's menu, or in the Morphe settings.

options.description: Words or phrases filtered until you edit the list in the app.

patches.name: Force enable translate
patches.description: Offers to translate every post, not only those the server marks translatable.

patches.name: Handle custom twitter links
patches.description: Opens links to other X frontends, such as fxtwitter and vxtwitter, in the app. They have to be enabled under "Open by default" in the app's system settings.

options.description: Link hosts to open in the app. Subdomains are included.

patches.name: Hide Banner
patches.description: Hides the "See new posts" pill at the top of the timeline.

patches.name: Hide Community Notes
patches.description: Hides Community Notes under posts.

patches.name: Hide FAB
patches.description: Hides the floating Post button.

patches.name: Hide badges from navigation bar icons
patches.description: Hides the unread counts and dots on the bottom navigation bar.

patches.name: Hide promote button
patches.description: Hides the Boost button on your posts and the Boost item in their menu.

patches.name: Hook feature flag
patches.description: Overrides the app's feature switches with values chosen when patching.

options.description: One key=value per entry, e.g. some_feature_enabled=true. true and false set a boolean, whole numbers an integer, other numbers a decimal, and anything else a string.

patches.name: Import/Export login token
patches.description: Adds Export login and Import login to the Morphe settings, opened from the app icon's shortcuts. An export holds everything needed to use your account.

patches.name: Legacy share links
patches.description: Shares posts as x.com/<username>/status/<id> rather than x.com/i/status/<id>.

patches.name: Native downloader
patches.description: Lets every photo, video and GIF be saved from its long-press menu and the media viewer, without a watermark.

patches.name: Native reader mode
patches.description: Adds "Reader mode" to the post menu: the post's text, selectable, with links to its media.

patches.name: Native translator
patches.description: Adds "Translate with Google" to the post menu.

patches.name: No shortened URL
patches.description: Opens links in posts at their real address instead of through t.co.

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Removes promoted posts, accounts and trends from timelines.

patches.name: Remove premium upsell
patches.description: Removes Premium upsells: the Upgrade button on the home timeline, the Premium side bar row, and the Get verified cards and prompts.

patches.name: Share Tweet as Image
patches.description: Adds "Share as image" to the share sheet of a post, which shares it as an image card.

patches.name: Show poll results
patches.description: Shows the results of polls without voting. Polls cannot be voted on while this is applied.

patches.name: Show sensitive media
patches.description: Shows media marked sensitive without blurring it behind a warning.

patches.name: Support external downloader
patches.description: Adds "Open in downloader" to the post menu, which shares the post's link with an app of your choice.

patches.name: Unlock Premium checks
patches.description: Makes the app's own Premium subscription checks always pass. Features the server enforces still need a subscription.
